_comment: Example Project AEGIS configuration. Copy to aegis.config.json and edit. NEVER put an API key, token, or password in this file — set AEGIS_LLM_AUTH_HEADER in your environment instead.

provider._comment: default 'offline' is deterministic and needs no credentials. To use a real local model server set AEGIS_LLM_URL and change default to a model name.

budget._comment: All limits are optional. null means 'no limit'. pricing must be filled in by the operator from their provider's published rate card — do not guess.
